purposes.introduced_version: A published source ledger is mandatory from this payload version; only later hosts initialize during explicit migration.
purposes.blue: Blue shares the fixed lot, carrying and formation limits. A lot funds eight cheap three-second delay parts; its fixed 4% Frost find is optional, never required for work or manufacture.
purposes.green: Green shares the same fixed lot, carrying and capped formation limits. Two resin fund an affordable two-receiver signal junction; the fixed 4% Preserving find is a bonus.
purposes.home_index_and_offsets: A discoverable source on the clear margin of an existing reachable home opportunity, leaving its building centre free. Only the opt-in Living Frontier world owns these hosts.
purposes.lots_and_units_per_lot: Each host holds eight fixed lots of sixteen units. Red supplies useful bricks and costly Ember; one White lot supplies eight cheap connections. White has no rare pool in Wave 1. Red's opportunity is fixed regardless of work or collection splits.
purposes.rare_per_10000: Four percent per Red lot offers a bonus Faint Ember; useful raw output and ordinary manufacture never require luck. Outcomes are fixed and saved at formation.
purposes.formation_seconds: After all eight lots and claims are exhausted, ten minutes of active overworld play reforms one manifestation. No offline, paused or trial growth. Ready stock banks no credit; an obstructed host holds at most one formation's credit.
purposes.work_stages: Four safe manual operations make the material's expose, vent, settle and draw sequence tangible for every class. Interruptions retain work; collection is a separate native transfer.
